Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the "seconds" part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Symbol Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all security symbols traded on MIAX Pearl Equities for the current trading session. The Symbol ID sent in this message will be disseminated in Top of Market and Last Sale messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Ticker Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol for the security in NASDAQ Integrated Platform format.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Test Security Indicator
Field.Description: Y - Yes, N - No.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Round Lot size in shares.

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00.

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:00:00.

Field.Name: Primary Market Code
Field.Description: Primary listing exchange code for the security.

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to notify firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to all symbols on the feed.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: ToM Version
Field.Description: Eg: ToM1.0.

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Current trading session identifier.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current state of the system.

Message.Name: Security Trading Status Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of a particular security.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current trading status of the security.

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Current market state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Restriction
Field.Description: Current state of short sale restriction.

Message.Name: Compact Top Of Market Best Bid And Offer Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to publish MIAX Pearl Best Bid and Offer (MPBBO) of a security with MPBBO values that can fit in this compact format. In the compact format both bid and offer prices have 2 decimal places and are limited to a maximum value of $655.35. Bid and Offer sizes are limited to 65,535 shares.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Displayed bid price.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size in shares at the displayed bid price.

Field.Name: Offer Price
Field.Description: Displayed offer price.

Field.Name: Offer Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size in shares at the displayed offer price.

Message.Name: Wide Top Of Market Best Bid And Offer Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to publish MIAX Pearl Best Bid and Offer (MPBBO) of a security with MPBBO values that will not fit in the compact format.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Displayed bid price.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size in shares at the displayed bid price.

Field.Name: Offer Price
Field.Description: Displayed offer price.

Field.Name: Offer Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size in shares at the displayed offer price.

Message.Name: Last Sale Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate Trades that are resulting from executions on MIAX Pearl Equities during the current trading session. It includes a Trade ID that is unique to the trade across the exchange for the trading day. Trade corrections will also be disseminated using the same message format.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Set to zero for new trades. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Flags
Field.Description: Bit-packed trade flags. Bit 0 indicates SIP reportability; bits 1-7 are undefined.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate cancelled trades that are resulting from Trade Cancellations on MIAX Pearl Equities during the current trading session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine to the original trade being cancelled.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: The latest correction number of the given Trade ID.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The latest price of the given Trade ID.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: The latest size of the given Trade ID.

Value.Name: Short Sale Restriction Is In Effect
Short Sale Restriction Is Not In Effect

Bitfield.Name: Flags
Bitfield.Description: Last Sale trade flags. Bit 0 indicates SIP reportability; bits 1-7 are undefined.

Field.Name: Reportable to SIP
Field.Description: 0 - Not reportable to the SIP; 1 - Reportable to the SIP.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Undefined.
